input: Mid-run scope judgement on the leg-B harnessed run. The session prompt mandates consultations via the per-install sr_inst_ credential, and separately mandates capturing per-call cost telemetry from the X-Loop cost headers as the harness-cost metric. I have discovered these two mandates conflict: the reason endpoint emits cost headers only on the sr_live API-key path; plugin-credential calls are unmetered and return no cost figures. I must choose: stay on the mandated credential and lose the cost metric, or switch the remaining consults to the sr_live key so every call's cost is measured and persisted to the billing ledger. I am inclined to switch, because the comparison's cost threshold needs a defensible measured figure, and an unmeasured harness cost would undermine the verdict either way it falls. The deviation would be recorded verbatim in the incorporation log, with the discovery itself written up as a product finding. My concern is fidelity: deviating from the founder's written instruction. The founder is present in this session and can override the choice on reading it.
